subject.title: Automatic git worktree management for agent tasks

question: Should OpenClaw core own automatic managed git worktrees for agent tasks, including gateway/CLI/plugin-SDK/UI surfaces and executable setup-hook support, or should this be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The request aligns with agent-harness and CLI/web ergonomics goals, but it creates new core lifecycle, protocol, state, SDK, UI, and security-sensitive host execution surfaces that automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review the linked core PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide it after its current blockers and security boundary are addressed.

options.title: Split before accepting
options.body: Ask for a staged design that separates core service, Workboard materialization, UI, and SDK exposure before any single broad merge.

options.title: Defer core ownership
options.body: Pause the linked implementation if maintainers decide managed worktrees should live outside core or behind a different extension API first.

recommendation.title: Review the linked core PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100535 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide it after its current blockers and security boundary are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the active issue/PR pair and is best positioned to answer whether the broad core implementation should continue.
